reason: Revision2 corrected the roof but its first native export retained large true wall voids below the upper balcony and around second-floor window heads. Replace projecting horizontal beams with thin wall-attached trim and make balconies shallow with solid joined bases, preserving the three-story bakery and striped awning.

visualReview.notes: Actually inspected generated front/right/back: three occupied floors and two balcony levels remain, the bakery display/entrance and orange-cream striped awning remain distinctive, and continuous light plaster now spans between flush windows. Horizontal trim is visibly thin and attached; balcony bases are continuous and shallow with fewer detached brackets. The right roof is a single rectangular continuous tile slope with level ridge/eave and no chimney. Reference-only semantic acceptance, not final model approval.
